$comment: R82 (D218): spells cast right after a weapon hit, offered in the on-hit window beside 신성한 강타. damage is added to the swing (dice doubled on a critical); inflicts lands with the hit; save is rolled by the target against the caster's spell save DC and posted as its own card. weapon: melee (default), ranged or any. Divine Smite stays the built-in rider. A module may put the same object under its spell-mechanic config as "onHit".

dnd.srd521.spell.shining-smite.note: 대상은 빛남 — 대상을 향한 명중에 이점, 투명 불가 (표에서)

save.note: 구속된 동안 매 턴 시작에 1d6 관통 (슬롯 레벨당 +1d6) — 표에서
